text: This staff report is about a matter which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval from Toronto and East York Community Council to convert Permit Parking on Draper Street, between Wellington Street West and Front Street West from the "Area Based" to the "Street Specific" Permit Parking Program. Transportation Services recommends approval of this proposal as it will allow greater parking flexibility for residents of Draper Street.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the conversion of Draper Street, between Wellington Street West and Front Street West from the "Area Based" to "Street Specific" Permit Parking Program.
